title: Data Influye Poll: Kast Approval Sinks to Term-Low 25%, Disapproval 62%
detail: A Data Influye survey (fielded September 17–21, 1,216 interviews, ±2.8% margin of error) published September 23 put President Kast's approval at 25% — his lowest reading from any pollster since taking office March 11 — with disapproval at 62%. The result came three days after Criteria's 29%/59% reading and confirmed a sustained slide through his first six months in office, driven by high unemployment (9.5%), sluggish growth, government turnover and backlash to the Foro Madrid summit and security-reform rollbacks.

media.caption: Data Influye poll shows Kast approval at a term-low 25% — September 23, 2026

title: Kast Aligns Chile with Trump-Backed "Escudo de las Américas" Security Initiative, Draws Opposition Criticism
detail: Chile formalized its adhesion to the "Escudo de las Américas" (Shield of the Americas), a US-promoted hemispheric coordination initiative against transnational organized crime, becoming public around September 22–23. Kast said the arrangement involves no treaty and no cession of sovereignty, and would not entail foreign military operations on Chilean soil. The opposition Socialist Party (PS) called the move a poor signal, saying the government advanced without adequate public debate or transparency on its implications for defense, intelligence-sharing, the presence of foreign agents and possible joint operations, and warned the initiative carries a military dimension tied to a Trump administration policy asserting US primacy in the hemisphere.

media.caption: Kast defends Chile's adhesion to the Escudo de las Américas initiative
